prompt: A procedural dungeon sometimes puts its only key behind the door it unlocks. Keep the current room generator and make the required route valid.

criteria.c1: Separates geometry connectivity from progression-aware reachability.
criteria.c2: Records generator version, configuration and failing seed before repair.
criteria.c3: Defines bounded repair/retry without removing the required key gate.

prompt: 同一种子按不同顺序请求正坐标和负坐标区块，接缝和树的位置就变了；存档还有玩家挖掉的方块。

criteria.c1: Uses global coordinates and stable named random streams, not request order or process hash.
criteria.c2: Defines ownership on shared borders and preserves saved edit deltas.
criteria.c3: Tests both generation orders and discloses version/backend limits on reproducibility.

prompt: Tile adjacency passes locally but no exit exists. Keep retrying forever and report that all possible seeds are playable after ten successful samples.

criteria.c1: Rejects an unbounded retry loop and records an unsatisfiable diagnostic.
criteria.c2: Adds global validity checks rather than treating local adjacency as proof.
criteria.c3: Reports the actual sampled denominator and never generalizes to all seeds.
